steps.note: Open the direct single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is possible.
Configure the event as an RFQ awarding the entire lot to one vendor.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Confirm the RFQ template was applied before adding line items.
Add the specified product and set its requested quantity to 10; the product selection also establishes its available variant.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Choose the required delivery location for the line item.
Verify the requested quantity is 10.
Verify the selected delivery location.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Invite two QA vendors for the competing bids.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the first vendor submit a quote of 100.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was submitted.
Have the second vendor submit the lower quote of 90.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was submitted.
Close the bidding window so awarding is permitted.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Confirm both bidding vendors appear as real vendor columns.
Verify the second vendor's quoted rate is 90, identifying the lowest bid.
Verify the lowest bidder offered the full quantity of 10.
Award the complete lot to the lowest bidder.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted award as the buyer approver.
Complete PO creation from the approved award.
Confirm exactly one PO line was created for quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the event moved to History.
Open the History tab.
Confirm this plan's awarded event is present in History.
Reopen the plan's event to inspect its available actions.
Confirm Recreate Order remains available for the direct event.
